summary: A large, imposing rectangular structure featuring alternating horizontal bands of stone and wood, flanked by four tall, dark stone towers at each corner. The central building is topped with a large, elongated wooden dome or barrel vault.

shape.overall_form: Central rectangular block with four corner towers and a domed roof

rebuild_hints: Lay out a rectangular base with four square tower footprints at the corners.
Build the main walls with alternating horizontal layers of stone bricks and wood planks.
Construct the tall corner towers using dark stone blocks, adding small windows at regular intervals.
Add white vertical pillars along the lower half of the main walls for detail.
Create a large, stepped wooden elongated dome over the central rectangular section.
Place light sources on the top center of the dome and each of the four towers.
uncertainties: Specific variant of dark stone used for the towers.
